title: Heterogeneous Catalysis
description: A catalyst holds a molecule on its surface just long enough to change it: neither too weakly nor too tightly (Sabatier). Unlocks the Catalyst Formulator and the Nickel Catalyst.

puzzle.goal: Gas at pressure P sticks to a surface with an equilibrium constant K, one molecule to a site. Write the share θ of the sites taken.
puzzle.name: Langmuir isotherm
puzzle.ask: Find θ for K = @{K} per atm and P = @{P} atm.
puzzle.method: Molecules land on empty sites (∝ P·(1 − θ)) and leave occupied ones (∝ θ); balance the two.
